products.name: Krita AI
products.note: Open-source digital art; local AI plugins; no cloud dependency; community governance

profile_text.body:
The Krita Foundation is a nonprofit, open-source foundation that develops and maintains Krita, a digital painting and art application distributed freely to users. The foundation's governance model is community-based, and the project carries no cloud dependency, meaning the software runs locally on users' machines rather than relying on external hosted services.

On the AI side, the foundation offers Krita AI, an open-source digital art tool with support for local AI plugins. Because all AI functionality operates locally, users are not required to send data to cloud infrastructure, which the foundation presents as a distinguishing characteristic of its approach.

The site's tracked facts confirm the foundation holds a profile on theworldofai.org, is categorized as a nonprofit open-source organization, and carries no recorded litigation or MCP server registrations at this time.
